Voting 
All residents who claim Wilton as their domicile, who are United States citizens, and who will be 18 years or older on election day are eligible to vote. There is no minimum period of time you are required to have lived in town before being allowed to register. 
VOTER QUALIFICATIONS 
Residents who claim Wilton as their domicile, who are United States citizens, and who will be 18 years or older on election day, are eligible to vote. There is no minimum period of time you are required to have lived in town before being allowed to register. 
Your  domicile  is that place, more than any other, where you sleep most nights of the year, or where you intend to return after a temporary absence. 
Examples of temporary absence include: 
Military and overseas voters 
Residents of nursing, convalescent, hospital and long term care facilities 
Teachers or students 
Persons incarcerated 
Persons navigating water 
THERE ARE FOUR WAYS TO REGISTER TO VOTE  -- 
Each requires proof of age, citizenship, and  Wilton domicile  - by document or affidavit. 
You may register to vote  at the Town Clerk's office  up to 10 days before any election. 
The Town Clerk's Office is located at the 42 Main St, Wilton. 
The Town Clerk hours are Monday and Tuesday  9:00am-2:00pm and Thursday from 9:00am-6:00pm. 
You may also register to vote  with your local Supervisors of the Checklist. 
They are required to meet at designated times to accept registrations and changes in party affiliation (see calendar). 
Please contact Town Office at (603) 654-9451 X-1 for more information. 
You may also register to vote  on the day of any election, at the polling place. 
You may register  absentee, by mail.  If you are unable to register in person because of physical disability, religious beliefs, military service, or because of temporary absence - you may register by mail. You should request an absentee voter registration affidavit and a standard voter registration form from the Town Clerk. The absentee voter registration affidavit must be witnessed and then both the affidavit and the voter registration form are to be returned to the Town Clerk (PO Box 83, Wilton, NH 03086). Please allow enough time for this to all happen through the US Mail.
